class.name: NNBTParallel
class.brief_description: Runs all enabled child branches concurrently and combines their outcomes using success and failure policies.
class.description: Use when an AI needs to do multiple things at once (such as moving toward a target while aiming, or running an action alongside a monitoring condition). Children that have already finished in the current run are remembered and not re-ticked until the next run; children still returning [constant NNBTNodes.RUNNING] keep ticking. [member success_policy] and [member failure_policy] decide when the parallel finishes (by default, it succeeds once all children succeed and fails as soon as any child fails). As soon as the outcome is decided, any still-running children are interrupted.

members.member: Whether failing requires one child ([constant FAILURE_REQUIRE_ONE], default) or all children ([constant FAILURE_REQUIRE_ALL]).
Whether succeeding requires all children ([constant SUCCESS_REQUIRE_ALL], default) or just one child ([constant SUCCESS_REQUIRE_ONE]). [constant NNBTNodes.SKIP] counts as success.

constants.constant: Succeeds only when every enabled child succeeds. This is the default.
Succeeds as soon as at least one enabled child succeeds.
Fails as soon as at least one enabled child fails. This is the default.
Fails only when every enabled child fails.
